paper_title: First Constraints on Nuclear Coupling of Axionlike Particles from the Binary Neutron Star Gravitational Wave Event GW170817
notes: Binary neutron star inspiral GW170817 constrains light axions coupling to nuclear matter similar to QCD axion. Bayesian analysis of gravitational waveform at 3σ confidence excludes axions with decay constants fa in [1.6×10^16 GeV, 10^18 GeV] for masses ma ≤ 10^-11 eV. Reported curve is the upper boundary of excluded fa region: fa = 1.6×10^16 GeV = 1/f_a = 6.25×10^-17 GeV^-1, approximately flat across mass range 10^-20 to 10^-11 eV. For fa > 10^18 GeV, NSs cannot trigger phase transition so no constraint. Constraint is model-independent, independent of dark matter assumption, and rules out parameter space previously unexplored by terrestrial or astrophysical experiments.
